tools.name: corregir_aranes
tools.description: Check and correct a text written in Aranese (aranés, Val d'Aran Occitan) following the IEA norm: spelling, grammar, Catalan/Spanish interferences and general-Occitan forms. Returns the corrected text and the list of problems. Use it on every Aranese text before giving it to the user.

tools.name: tradusir_aranes
tools.description: Translate between Aranese (oc) and Spanish (es) or Catalan (ca): es→oc, ca→oc, oc→es, oc→ca. Machine translation with A punt's own corrections; for important texts, check the result with corregir_aranes.

tools.name: diccionari_aranes
tools.description: Look up a single word in the Aranese dictionary: from Aranese (oc) it gives category, pronunciation, Spanish and Catalan translations, forms or conjugation and synonyms; from Spanish (es) or Catalan (ca) it gives the Aranese equivalents. Without 'lengua' it tries oc, then es, then ca.

tools.name: guia_aranes
tools.description: Short guide to write Aranese correctly (IEA norm): articles, compulsory contractions, common words and typical errors from Catalan, Spanish and general Occitan. Read it before writing Aranese.
